title: Special Needs Preparedness
description: Covers medication, mobility equipment, diet, and cognitive needs for elders, an infant supply kit and feeding, and planning for power-dependent equipment and hearing, vision, mobility, and cognitive disabilities. Includes service animals, evacuating mobility-impaired people, caregiver backup plans, and a documentation packet.
shortDescription: Planning for elders, infants, disabilities, and service animals
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
